proposals.content:
**An Unforgettable Day with Lil Nouns and 180 Girls**

**Organizer:** SailorNouns + Surf for Good

**Location: **Búzios (RJ), Brazil

**🏄‍♀️ About Surf for Good**

Founded in 2021 in Búzios (RJ), Surf for Good is a social project that empowers girls from public schools, aged 7 to 17, through a unique combination of education, sports, and personal development.

**💫 Because a happy day can change everything**

In 2023, the project held an unforgettable party that deeply impacted the lives of many girls in Búzios. Due to costs, the celebration couldn’t happen again.

Now, with Lil Nouns' support, we want to bring back this transformative experience.

**_Playing, belonging, and being cared for is a right every day._**

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmXmnykxqS7QZFtiRMocS8MEaxXVpTHf5Rc32a9nszHeEe)

[Link](https://i.imgur.com/zHZXSY3.gif)

**💡 The Idea**

To organize a big one-day celebration in Búzios, filled with joy and a sense of belonging, for 180 girls from Surf for Good and their families.

A fun, welcoming day full of purpose, with the spirit of Lil Nouns: colorful, collective, and inspiring.

**🧸 What we’ll have:**

- Water slides and soap soccer

- Jetski tours

- Trampoline

- Community snacks

- Lil Nouns cups

- Face painting 

- Video/photo Registration

- Reaffle: Kendama, pins, paper noggles. 

- Lil Nouns-themed decoration

**🧠 Real Impact**

- Childhood celebrated in a safe and welcoming way

- Over 180 girls directly impacted

- Active involvement of families, educators, and volunteers

- Create lasting emotional memories

- Strengthening Surf for Good as a local socialreference

**🧾 Estimated Budget**

- Inflatables rental (water slides, bubble soccer, trampoline) - 0.18 ETH 

- Venue & volunteers (space, volunteers, photography, transport of the girls) - Cost covered

- Jetski/Boat Tour - Cost covered

- Food (sandwiches, fruits, cake, juice, etc) - 0.07 ETH

- Custom cups (Lil Nouns branded, take-home) - 0.03 ETH 

- Decoration (colorful Lil Nouns theme) - 0.03 ETH

- Face painting (covered by leftover budget) - 0.02 ETH

**Total: 0.33 ETH**

proposals.content:
**Overview:**
FOUNS (Feeding Our Urban Nouns) is an initiative to spread and deploy street feeders for stray animals, blending public art with community engagement. Utilizing recycled plastic, we aim to produce two sizes:

- **Small:** Suitable for cats and small dogs.
- **Large:** Designed for larger dogs and covered public spaces.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmQYEU7ZVdviGsHBtLajpuYF6dE1ArTkzyaXRci8iEmcCb)

The mold will enable us to produce feeders units cheaply with sustainably. With it, we can test real-world acceptance in different communities before seeking a larger expansion grant.

**Phase 1: Design Development**

- **Community Collaboration:** 
- Commission a designer from the Nouns community to create two prototype designs based on our existing concept.
- Present both designs for community voting to select the preferred model.

**Phase 2: Prototyping**

- **Dual Fabrication:** Partner with two professionals to produce prototypes using recycled plastic.
- **Evaluation:** Assess prototypes for durability, aesthetics, and cost-effectiveness, then share findings with the community.

**Phase 3: Community Engagement**

- **QR Code :** Each FOUNS unit will feature a QR code linking to educational content about animal welfare and the Nouns ecosystem.
- **Global Outreach:** Establish partnerships with animal welfare advocates and organizations worldwide to promote the initiative.
- **Sustainability: **We seek to give a new life to all plastic recovered from nature, and inspire people to do same in different places across the planet.
- **Unused Funds (Reinvestment):** Any remaining funds will be allocated to purchase Lil Nouns tokens, reinvesting in the community that supports this project.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmQwCGAPpjB8HX4NEpCDi7F43qCzTkXXku5WEftCHLnqiE)

**Invitation  :**
Anyone who wants to be part of the FOUNS movement — as a local representative, global partner, or creative collaborator blending ideas and formats — is warmly invited to join us. You’re more than welcome here.

proposals.content:
Crazy Sixteen is a cultural institution that has transformed the breaking scene in Colombia through four successful editions. This year, we're dedicating the fifth edition to children. An ecosystem that includes workshops for vulnerable populations, flash public activations, and artistic showcases that will bring breaking to new spaces.

The previous edition received support from Nouns Amigos and Nouns Breakers, this collaboration demonstrates our ability to execute high-impact events that resonate with the community. See last CRAZY SIXTEEN recap: [https://acortar.link/O6wi4Z](https://acortar.link/O6wi4Z)

For many children, Crazy Sixteen will be their first competitive experience, with an innovative format evaluated by our Digital Scoring System, unique in Latin America. The collaboration between Lil Nouns and "Lil Breakers" represents a synergy that builds future, democratizes access, and strengthens communities.

Activities

• Two surprise events where a boy and a girl will win direct spots to the final event.

• Two masterclasses for kids competitors.

• Four sessions at a child protection center, impacting 30 children.

• Four presentations at strategic points throughout the city.

Impact and sustainability

The event will gather 120 children from all over Colombia. The presentations will impact another 300 people. The event brings together participants and their families, creating an intergenerational community.

We will document the entire process with professional photos, a video recap, and social media posts. Lil Nouns will be visible on: kit accessories, photo backgrounds for the public, certificates, and on the champion's trophy.

Budget

We provide: trainers, kits for vulnerable population, showcase artists, logistics, technical production, and scoring system.

The 0.33 ETH from Lil Nouns will be allocated to: prizes for 48 winning children and bonuses for the top two (breaking mat, speaker, Lil Nouns branded clothing, certificate, and web3 opportunities counseling)View more: [https://flows.wtf/marsue](https://flows.wtf/marsue)

**
Objective**: 

Our local health center is the first point of contact for hundreds of residents seeking medical care. However, the facility currently suffers from poor infrastructure, limited supplies, and an uncomfortable environment for both patients and healthcare workers. This proposal aims to make low-cost but high impact improvements that will restore basic dignity and functionality to the space. With support, we will create a healthier, safer, and more welcoming environment for all .

**Key Actions**:  
1. Facility Repairs: Repair/replace  damaged benches/chairs, window ; repaint walls with durable washable paint.  
2. Ventilation: Install  energy-efficient ceiling fans to improve airflow.  
3. Supplies: Stock  essentials (gloves, masks, disinfectants, soap).  
4. Education: Display visual posters (local language) on disease prevention, hygiene, and nutrition.  
5. The Lil Nouns logo will be displayed on the health centre building.

6. Progress and impact will be shared through photos, testimonials, and updates

**Expected Impact**:  
→ Higher Clinic Attendance: Clean, cool environment attracts women, children, and elderly for timely care.  
→ Reduced Infections: Improved ventilation and hygiene lower disease transmission.  
→ Empowered Staff: Organized workspace boosts morale and efficiency.  
→ Health Literacy: Clear visuals encourage preventive practices.

**Budget Breakdown ($700):**  
- Repairs & Paint: $200  
- Furniture: $150  
- Medical Supplies: $150  
- Cleaning Kits: $50  
- Fans: $50  
- Posters: $20  
- Logistics: $30  

- photo and video = $50

**Sustainability**:

Health centre staff will oversee maintenance and supply use. Community volunteers will be involved in the initial work, fostering shared responsibility. 

**Community Involvement:**

1. Volunteers will help with cleaning, painting, and setup
2. Local leaders and health staff will guide and monitor use of supplies.

proposals.content:
We’re launching a cannabis-forward pop-up experience that blends **entertainment, community building, and holistic education** in a safe, inclusive environment. At the heart of this experience is our **Open Decks series**—a platform where emerging DJs, artists, and creatives come together to perform, connect, and build community through sound and shared culture. 

Our pop-ups feature **high-quality local BIPOC prioritized and ally vendors**, offering curated products that align with conscious consumption—ranging from infused beverages and wellness goods to handcrafted art, apparel, and accessories. Each event is designed to be a **multisensory experience**, fusing music, visual art, informative cannabis culture, and ancestral herbalism. What sets us apart is our commitment to **empowering consumers through education**. 

We incorporate interactive elements like **microscope tutorials**, terpene and trichome ID, and a **grading system** that helps guests better understand the cannabis they’re using—from bag appeal to effect. This promotes informed choices while reducing harm and increasing appreciation for legal cannabis offerings in the recreational market. We prioritize wellness and safety, providing a space where attendees can learn, express, and unwind. 

Whether it’s dancing, vending, learning, or creating, our events foster connection and uplift the community—especially BIPOC creatives and cannabis workers often excluded from mainstream narratives. Our vision is to **cultivate a cultural movement** where cannabis, art, and education come together to inspire, inform, and empower.

Across the world, the number of homeless children continues to rise due to economic hardship, displacement, conflict, and family breakdown. These children, often seen on the streets or living in temporary shelters, face daily battles for survival—without food, clean clothes, healthcare, or education.
---

2. Project Overview

Project Title: Hope for the Forgotten
Budget: $700
Duration: 3 months
Target Beneficiaries: 50 homeless or vulnerable children (aged 6–15)

This project will deliver basic humanitarian support to 50 homeless children through the provision of essential supplies, informal learning, basic health care, and psychosocial support.

3. Objectives

Overall Goal:
To provide relief and support for homeless children in a marginalized community by meeting their basic needs and offering informal learning and psychosocial engagement.

Specific Objectives:

Distribute food, hygiene items, and clothing to 50 children.

Facilitate informal learning sessions twice weekly.

Offer basic medical care and health education.

Conduct weekly group activities to improve mental and emotional well-being.

4. Rationale

The image reflects a neglected reality—children growing up without adequate protection or opportunities. Left without intervention, these children risk becoming victims of abuse, disease, malnutrition, and crime. This proposal aims to offer immediate aid and provide a safe space for learning and care.

Even with a limited budget, this project can change lives. By addressing urgent needs and planting seeds of hope, we empower these children to imagine a future beyond survival.

---

5. Key Activities

a. Distribution of Basic Needs

Each child will receive:

Hygiene kit (soap, toothpaste, toothbrush, sanitary pads for girls)

Food pack (rice, beans, oil)

A pair of slippers

As part of our mission to regenerate ecosystems and create real-world impact within the Nouns ecosystem, this project channels funds into the restoration of Brazil’s unique restinga biome — a coastal ecosystem under serious threat.

**🌿 What We’re Doing:**

We’ll plant 50 native seedlings in degraded areas, restoring biodiversity, strengthening climate resilience, and protecting coastal habitats.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmdVgrcGoXsrfAToVcmjmndovU5QbcJhxCmsVKnKC451bJ)

**✅ Why It Matters:**

proposals.content:
Our **“Back to School”** project will support 50 orphaned children by providing backpacks, notebooks, pens, pencils, erasers, and art kits— to kids between the age bracket of 8-15 yrs. and also covering one term’s school fees for the children with disabilities who face the biggest barriers to attendance.

On distribution day, we’ll run a **“My Future Self” Storytelling** activity: older kids write a short narrative of where they see themselves in ten years; younger ones draw their dreams. We’ll also offer a **teaser introduction to Lil Nouns**—showing how a global creative community can fuel local impact—and for teens, a **brief NFT primer**: what NFTs are, why they matter, and how to start exploring Web3.

**Partnerships & Volunteers:**
We’ll collaborate with local orphanages to select beneficiaries and coordinate logistics. A team of community volunteers will sort and hand out supplies, facilitate storytelling and workshops, and document the day with photos and short video clips.

**Execution Timeline (3 months):**

- **Weeks 1–2:** Confirm orphanage partnerships, select 50 children, (fees stipends) recruit volunteers, purchase supplies, arrange stipends.
- **Weeks 3–4:** Book and prep venue, design/print activity sheets, promote the event via social media and local posters.
- **Week 5 (Event Day):** Distribute materials & stipends; run “My Future Self” sessions, give Lil Nouns overview and NFT primer,  document the day.
- **Weeks 6–8:** Edit/share a 2-minute recap video, gather feedback, send thank-you note to lil noun Follow up n fully onboarding them

**Budget Summary (0.33 ETH):**

- Supplies (50 kids): 0.17 ETH
- School-fee stipends : 0.05 ETH
- Venue & logistics: 0.05 ETH
- Activity materials: 0.02 ETH
- Documentation: 0.02 ETH
- Contingency: 0.02 ETH

By tapping local partners and volunteers, every fraction of 0.33 ETH directly empowers these children—providing both the tools to learn and the inspiration to envision a brighter future in school and beyond

proposals.content:
**Summary:**
This proposal is focused on renovating **Devine Academy Orba**, a community-founded rural school serving children from low-income farming families in Orba, Nsukka. The school currently enrolls over **150 students but** deteriorating infrastructure and a lack of learning materials are hampering their ability to learn. With this grant, we aim to create a safe, engaging, and well-equipped learning environment that will immediately improve student outcomes and restore community pride in local education.

**Community Context:**
Orba is a remote farming village where most households survive on less than **20,000 NGN (~$12)** per month. Devine Academy was established by the community and the local church to give children access to education without the financial burden of urban schools. Despite their dedication, the school remains under-resourced and in urgent need of support.

**Current Challenges:**
The school suffers from leaking roofs, cracked floors, broken windows, and poor lighting. Many students sit on the floor or share desks meant for one. There are not enough blackboards, textbooks, or basic materials like pens, notebooks, science kits, or math tools—making effective teaching almost impossible.

**Previous Support:**
Last year, the **Rotaract Club of the University of Nigeria**, of which I am a member, donated benches, books, and sanitary supplies (proof: [https://www.instagram.com/p/DAlvUDuMZUz/).](https://www.instagram.com/p/DAlvUDuMZUz/).) While helpful, it wasn’t enough to meet the school’s broader needs.

![](https://db.lilnouns.wtf/api/funding/images/QmXCF7VDVUVHdhEPmP8viguUCBe3TskzSKDHUhUnijtAVH)
**Expected Outcomes:**
**Short-term:** safer classrooms, better attendance, more effective teaching
**Long-term:** improved academic results, higher student engagement, and stronger community investment in education

**Success Metrics:**
We will track school attendance, document renovations with before-and-after photos, and collect teacher feedback.

With just **0.33 ETH**, we can transform a struggling rural school and give over 150 children a conducive environment to learn and build for real-world success

**Organized by: Planet Lukukul**

**What is SOURCE DAY?**

**SOURCE DAY** is a two-day creative experience where musicians, writers, animators, visual artists, and other creative people come together to make powerful new work.

It’s a space where ideas flow, collaborations happen, and artists leave with real work done—not just talk. It also includes time for rest and reflection, like short wellness sessions and creative advice from experienced mentors.

**Why It Matters**

Most creative events in Nigeria are about performing or networking. This one is about actually **creating**—in one day, with others who care about quality and impact.

Artists get to:

- Work on music, animation, lore building , artworks or visuals
- Develop stories and world-building ideas
- Get advice, pointers and support
- Try something new in a relaxed but focused space
- Leave with actual content, drafts, or concepts

**Who It’s For**

- Musicians, producers, and songwriters
- Animators and illustrators
- Writers and storytellers
- Visual artists and designers
- Yoga/mindfulness instructors
- Creative consultants and brand builders

11:00 AM.  Welcome + Set Intentions

11:30 AM.   Light Yoga & Breathwork (30 mins)

12:00 PM.   Creative Session 1: Everyone works in groups (music, visuals, story, etc.)

**Introduction**:

Our local community faces growing issues of street litter, blocked drainage systems, and neglected public spaces. These conditions pose health risks, contribute to flooding, and reduce the quality of life for residents. In response, a group of dedicated local youth have launched a weekly cleanup campaign to reclaim these shared spaces.

With the support of Lil Nouns DAO, this initiative can grow into a model of community-led impact powered by creativity, volunteerism, and the decentralized ethos that defines Lil Nouns.

**Objective**:

The goal of this project is to restore and maintain cleaner, safer public areas through weekly cleanups. Specifically, we aim to:

Improve public health and sanitation by removing waste and clearing blocked drainage.

Foster civic pride by involving local youth and volunteers in meaningful action.

Promote Lil Nouns DAO values through creative branding and open participation.

This effort will not only beautify the environment but also inspire others to take ownership of their surroundings and believe in the power of collective action.

**Budget Breakdown**

Promotional Materials (Flyers, Posters, Online Ads): $50

Cleaning Tools & Supplies (Shovels, Brooms, Gloves, Trash Bags): $200

Volunteer Refreshments (Water, Snacks): $100

Waste Transport (Local Hauling Services): $150

Branding & Apparel (DIY T-shirts, Banners with Lil Nouns designs): $200

Total Requested: $700 (0.33 ETH)

**What Difference Will This Make?**

This project will lead to tangible and lasting change, including:

Cleaner Streets: Removing accumulated waste will make public areas safer and more appealing.

Reduced Flood Risk: Clearing drainage channels helps prevent water overflow during rains.

Empowered Youth: Local volunteers will gain leadership experience and a sense of ownership.

Each cleanup sends a powerful message: with a little support, everyday people can drive meaningful change in their own neighborhoods.

In "BALANCING WITH MOMBAÇA", we want to bring our balanced methodology to the fishing community of Mombaça, Saquarema, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The community of Mombaça is made up of 2,000 people, and their main source of income is fishing. The community has a school, a soccer field, ideal for outdoor activities with a large number of people, and a residents' association located next to the school, ideal for discussions about the development of the project.

With the funding, we will be able to invest in more hula hoops and publicity to spread the word about Nouns. The hula hoops will remain with the community for continued learning of what is shared.

The hula hoops are made of polyamide, resistant to sea spray and impact.
